description: This file contains a script to perform load testing and benchmarking of different language model APIs, including LiteLLM and OpenAI, by making asynchronous API calls and measuring response times.

classes.name: AsyncAzureOpenAI
classes.description: Asynchronous client class for Azure OpenAI API.

methods.name: openai_completion
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous chat completion request using the Azure OpenAI client.

methods.name: router_completion
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous chat completion request through the LiteLLM router.

methods.name: proxy_completion_non_streaming
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous non-streaming chat completion request via the LiteLLM client.

methods.name: loadtest_fn
methods.description: Runs a load test by firing multiple concurrent completion requests and measuring total elapsed time.
